messages:
devon: FYI finance pinged me about a weird delta in the hosted billing vs our reserved GPU commitments for us-west1. Quick thread to surface numbers and decide a short-term safety margin. TL;DR: model shows ~12% overage in peak windows for Apr.
anya: Can you drop the raw numbers here? region/committed/observed/peak-window would help.
devon: Sure — pasted from the query: ```region,committed_gpus,observed_peak_gpus,avg_util_peak,estimated_overage_pct
us-west1,480,538,0.78,12.1
us-east1,420,415,0.71,-1.2
eu-central1,200,188,0.64,-6.0
ap-southeast1,60,74,0.81,23.3
``` Note ap-southeast looks small but high squeeze during APAC morning.
infra-bot: reservation-util-report: us-west1 7d p95 usage 0.76, committed headroom -58 GPUs during 14:00-16:00 UTC windows. Burst credits used: 18% of allowed. (auto)
mike: Two quick asks: 1) Are we comparing invoice amortized commit vs actual on-demand usage? finance-bot will show amortization schedule. 2) Any recent routing changes or feature launches that shifted traffic? @sarah
finance-bot: Invoice delta flagged: amortized commit vs actual line-item mismatch = $32.4k for Apr (US regions). Suggest review of reservation allocation tags.
sarah: We rolled out the low-latency embed endpoint on Apr 3 and routed more traffic to us-west by default for latency. That explains the spike. We can: - throttle the default or - enable cross-region spillover to eu-central for non-SLA traffic.
anya: For planning: let's run two scenarios: A) immediate safety margin +10% on us-west commitment; B) enable spillover policy for non-critical routes to eu-central and apac. I can run a forecast sim. Command I'll use: `/forecast-sim --region us-west1 --window Apr --safety 0.10 --outputs_csv` and another with `--spillover eu-central1 --spill_threshold 0.7`
mike: If spillover reduces peak by >8% we avoid buying more reservation months. Also check committed pricing bands — buying extra capacity may lower unit cost but increases fixed spend.
devon: Action items: - @anya run the two sims and post numbers by EOD PST (due 2061234500). - @sarah open a quick flag to throttle default routing for the embed endpoint (30% reduction target) and report impact in #product by EOD. - @mike and @finance-bot reconcile amortization tags and verify invoice mapping by EOD. If sims still show >8% overage, propose temporary 3-month top-up reservation purchase to cover peak. :pushpin:
anya: On it — kicking sims now, will paste CSV when done.
sarah: I'll bake the routing flag and coordinate with deploy window. Will update once feature toggle is live.
devon: Thanks all. If we need fast mitigation, consider enabling us-west burst credits for next 72h while sims run. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
